meta.title: Uha — Subscriptions Tracker for iOS
meta.description: Track subscriptions and spending, view upcoming payments, and set reminders on iOS. Start with 3 subscriptions free; Unlimited is a one-time purchase.
meta.short_description: Track subscriptions and upcoming payments on iOS. Up to 3 subscriptions free.

jsonld.free_tier: Up to 3 subscriptions, basic report currencies, forecasts up to 3 years, local backup creation, and CSV export
jsonld.unlimited_tier: One-time purchase: unlimited subscriptions, all report currencies, forecasts up to 12 years, manual iCloud backup and restore, local backup restoration, CSV import, and all future premium features
features: Local subscription tracking without a separate Uha account
List and calendar views of scheduled payments
All supported billing currencies in both plans
Currency conversion with historical rates, where available
Free local backup creation and CSV export
Manual iCloud backup and restore with Unlimited
